title: Carapace buckler

infobox.Crafting Materials: Carapace x16, Scale hide x6, Refined eitr x6

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The Carapace buckler is the third buckler shield. Its 2.5x parry bonus makes it superior for parrying attacks, but inferior for blocking. It currently has the highest parry block armor of any shield in the game.
It is the only shield in the game that provides 10 Adrenaline on Parry instead of 5.
